adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, when no topic_id is found it enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `loading`—it never calls `TopicRetriever` directly. However `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` (the "tells the topic retriever to work..." example) expects `TopicRetriever.new` to be called and `retrieve` invoked synchronously during the request. This is a direct contract mismatch in the diff and would cause that spec to fail against the shipped controller behavior.
